Usage: gelato pre-commit [flags]

Scan lines added in staged changes.

Exit codes: 0 when nothing is found, 1 when secrets are found, and 2 for any
other error, which is printed on stderr.

With --output-format=json, stdout is exactly one JSON document, {"found_issues":
[...]}, even when nothing is found. On exit code 2, stdout is empty. Each issue
has these keys:

  - file_path: the repository-relative path the string was added to.
  - matched_string: the exact flagged string, which may span lines.
  - signature: the finding's ID for exclude-signatures, computed from
    matched_string and file_path only.
  - issue_type: "Regular Expression" or "High Entropy".
  - issue_detail: the regex rule's name, or null for High Entropy.
  - lines: the added lines containing matched_string (every added line of the
    change when it spans lines). A line longer than 500 characters is cut to 80
    characters on each side of the match, or to its first 80 characters when it
    holds none of the match, and "…" marks each cut.

To resolve a finding, first decide whether matched_string is a real secret.

If it is, remove it from the file and rotate it at its issuer.

If it isn't, add one entry under [tool.tartufo] in tartufo.toml (or
pyproject.toml), with a reason. The default choice suppresses exactly this
string in this file:

    exclude-signatures = [{signature = "<signature>", reason = "<why this is not a secret>"}]

For files that are entirely generated or test data, skip every finding in files
whose path the regex matches from the start of file_path:

    exclude-path-patterns = [{path-pattern = '<regex>', reason = "<why>"}]

For High Entropy issues only, suppress every high-entropy string on a line that
pattern matches anywhere, in files whose path path-pattern matches anywhere;
path-pattern is optional:

    exclude-entropy-patterns = [{pattern = '<regex>', path-pattern = '<regex>', reason = "<why>"}]

Prefer the narrowest entry. Never put matched_string itself in the config:
exclude-signatures also accepts the raw string, and that would commit the
secret.

Flags:
  -h, --help                    Show context-sensitive help.
      --config=CONFIG           Read configuration from this file. Repeatable;
                                list values are concatenated in order.
      --no-color                Disable colored output.
      --output-format="text"    Report format: "text" for people, or "json" for
                                scripts and AI agents (exactly one JSON document
                                on stdout). See "gelato <command> --help" for
                                the JSON fields and how to resolve a finding.
  -V, --version                 Print the version and exit.
